summary: UIThemeLive: a scene load repaints only that scene's canvases now, prefab assets two frames later in one pass (was 0.85-2.3 s inside the load frame, B45). Tooling: BenchmarkReport.TryRunGit returns 'unknown' outside the editor (a Windows IL2CPP development build crashed on every DiagnosticsHUD capture: Process.Start asserts in IL2CPP Debug), and CosmicShoreBuildPipeline takes -il2cppRelease to build a development player with the Release IL2CPP config (the Debug config ran the menu at 12 fps, useless for perf).
